label: Students and qualifications of educational institutions by Year, Region 2025, Sector of Education and Information
note: From 2020 onwards, comprehensive school pupils and students are included in the data.
Data for 2020 have been corrected as concerns WinNova educational institution (6,768 persons added).

Data on pre-primary education pupils for 2021 has been corrected on 25 April 2023. The figures published previously on 25 October 2022 were a total of 58,570 in pre-primary education, 48,907 in connection with early childhood education and 9,663 in connection with comprehensive education.

Data on general upper secondary education for 2021 has been corrected on 25 April 2023. The figures published previously on 25 October 2022 were: number of students 107,247 and number of new students 36,900.
Data on pre-primary education provided in connection with early childhood education and care in Åland are not included in the number of students.
The figures for those having completed comprehensive education do not include data on Åland from 2020 onwards.
The data for 2022 do not include data on comprehensive education in the International School of Helsinki.

The table has been corrected 24.11.2023. There has been a small change in the number of foreign-language speakers for 2021 and 2022 in Table 11c4. The data on the first language of general upper secondary school students were changed for 200 students in the 2021 data and for 211 students in the 2022 data. Finnish was entered as the first language when it should be unknown.
